A '''Barrage Rocket''' was a type of [[Missile/Legends|rocket]] equipped on [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. At some point, a [[TIE/ag "Aggressor" Starfighter/Legends|TIE/AG Aggressor starfighter]] fired one.<ref name="X-Wing">{{FFGXW2|set=Galactic Empire Conversion Kit|cardname=Barrage Rockets}}</ref>
